title: Anomaly Detection via Autoencoder Composite Features and NCE
abstract: arXiv:2502.01920v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection is a challenging task. Autoencoders (AEs) or generative models are often employed to model the data distribution of normal inputs and subsequently identify anomalous, out-of-distribution inputs by high reconstruction error or low likelihood, respectively. However, AEs may generalize and achieve small reconstruction errors on abnormal inputs. We propose a decoupled training approach for anomaly detection that both an AE and a likelihood model trained with noise contrastive estimation (NCE). After training the AE, NCE estimates a probability density function, to serve as the anomaly score, on the joint space of the AE's latent representation combined with features of the reconstruction quality. To further reduce the false negative rate in NCE we systematically varying the reconstruction features to augment the training and optimize the contrastive Gaussian noise distribution. translated_title: 基于自编码器复合特征与噪声对比估计的异常检测
translated_abstract: 无监督异常检测是一项具有挑战性的任务。自编码器（AE）或生成模型通常被用来建模正常输入的数据分布，随后分别通过高重构误差或低似然来识别异常的分布外输入。然而，自编码器可能会产生泛化，在异常输入上获得较小的重构误差。我们提出了一种解耦训练的异常检测方法，其中同时包含一个自编码器和一个使用噪声对比估计（NCE）训练的似然模型。在训练完自编码器之后，NCE在自编码器的潜在表示与重构质量特征相结合的联合空间上估计概率密度函数，并将其作为异常评分。为了进一步降低NCE中的假阴性率，我们系统地变化重构特征以增强训练，并优化对比高斯噪声分布。在……上的实验评估（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种解耦训练的异常检测方法，将自编码器的潜在表示与重构质量特征结合，利用噪声对比估计（NCE）在该联合空间上估计概率密度作为异常评分，并通过系统变化重构特征和优化对比噪声分布来降低假阴性率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decoupled training approach for anomaly detection that combines autoencoder latent representations with reconstruction quality features, using noise contrastive estimation (NCE) to estimate a probability density on the joint space as an anomaly score, while systematically varying reconstruction features and optimizing the contrastive noise distribution to reduce the false negative rate.
